visualCharacteristics.purpose: Customer story testimonial with photo, large quote and attribution
visualCharacteristics.layout: photo beside quote and caption on desktop, stacked on mobile

contentPattern.structure: Single-cell rows: image (optional) | quote text | attribution (name, business, optional link to full story)

reuseGuidance: Use for customer quotes and story teasers. Omit the image row for a text-only quote.
